base_cell.recording_api: Simulation(record_sources=true, record_fields=false); observe probe modes [spikes, V_m]

axes_note: One factor varied per row around base. N trend 10->10000 keeps the balanced-EI builder pure; n1 is a dispatch-style endpoint anchor (documented builder note, not a pure N point).

cells.builder_note: balanced_ei_population, minimal recording, fixed W, single call
dispatch-style single neuron, point field (EI fractions undefined at n=1); endpoint anchor
balanced_ei_population n=10000, else base; expect heavy construct/first-call

cells.mechanism_api: Simulation(runtime=RuntimeConfig(enable_hdp=true, recurrent_backend=edge_list, jit=false, hdp_params={K_HDP:0.01, tau_0_ms:200.0, K_ctrl:5.0, barrier_c:0.01, barrier_d:0.01, H_min:0.1, H_max:10.0, w_min:-10.0, w_max:10.0})) — same params as scripts/benchmark_050_baseline.py _hdp_runtime

cells.builder_note: base builder on edge_list backend, 4 chained segments

cells.varies: AT-10 scale point (1d): 20 areas x 1000n = 20k neurons

cells.delay_rule: kernel-level EdgeList.delay_steps via edge_delay_steps_from_ms if reachable on the tensor construct path, else zero delay (recorded); if no existing path can couple the areas, measure 20 uncoupled columns and mark the coupled cell UNSUPPORTED with the reason

frozen_rules.warm_repeats: >=3 warm simulate calls per cell; report median + range (min/max); first call (compile+run) excluded from warm stats
frozen_rules.compile_estimate: compile_est_ms = max(0, first_call_ms - warm_median_ms); reported as estimate, not a fenced compile
frozen_rules.phases: construct_ms | simulate_first_call_ms (compile+run) | simulate_warm_ms (median+range over >=3) | probe_observe_ms (model.probe) | manifest_ms (model.manifest) — same phase timing as scripts/benchmark_050_baseline.py
frozen_rules.phase_to_item2: construct->construct; compile_est->compile; warm->warm step; warm deltas across recording axis + recording bytes->recording; probe+manifest->observe
frozen_rules.memory: measured process peak: psutil RSS sampled at every phase boundary PLUS a 10ms-interval peak-hold sampler thread during construct+simulate; report peak_mb + method string; declared array bytes (spikes/V_m/sources, HDP traces where present) reported alongside, as in baseline_050
frozen_rules.wall_budget: per-cell wall_budget_s above; over budget -> cell status SKIPPED_BUDGET with time-spent recorded; infeasible corners -> UNSUPPORTED with reason; never force
frozen_rules.bottleneck_thresholds: a phase is a bottleneck if >=25% of warm-total time (construct + warm + observe on the warm path; compile_est reported separately) or >=25% of peak memory in any cell
frozen_rules.env_receipt: every output carries jax/jaxlib versions, platform, cpu/device list (P-003 rule: ISSUE_LOG P-003 — frozen evidence must record the full environment)
frozen_rules.never_write: scripts/benchmark_051_matrix.py never writes artifacts/perf/baseline_050.json; baseline hash verified unchanged via git status at seal
frozen_rules.equivalence_default: bit-exact; any tolerance need stops that optimization and is reported for human authorization

outputs.harness: scripts/benchmark_051_matrix.py (reuses phase timing of scripts/benchmark_050_baseline.py + RSS method of scripts/profile_050_phases.py)

done_when: spec committed before any result; every cell MEASURED or marked UNSUPPORTED/SKIPPED_BUDGET with reason; baseline_050.json hash unchanged
